10. Inspector's information.

## Start with the maintenance records

Before beginning the inspection process, start by reviewing the existing maintenance records for the bridge. This provides a historical context for the condition of the bridge and helps identify any recurring issues or areas of concern. Look for previous inspection reports, repair records, and any other relevant documents that may shed light on the bridge's condition.
